description.en: Hold the knife, push, blow the dust away

howToPlay.zh: 照着篆刻师傅的工序刻一方四字印：先倒边，再刻边框、刻十字分成四格，最后一笔一笔刻字。刻刀分两个区域：按住白色刀柄拖动是移刀，按住朱红色握把（或刀身）划就是刻。印面上的小圈是落刀点：中间一道是刀口和槽宽，两个小箭头是刀能走的方向；悬空时黄色，刀在石头里时红色。落刀点靠近当前这一步的红色稿线时会吸到线上（靠近线头时吸到线头），稿线变黄就说明对准了；设置里可以关掉「对线辅助」。刀竖着时上下刻，横着时左右刻，点落刀点下方的 ⟳ 横竖切换；往前往回都能刻，已经刻过的地方刀会顺着槽滑过。刻的时候刀身变半透明，看得见刻出的槽。松手提刀，再按住握把接着刻。刻偏了点 ↶ 撤销最后一划，可以连续撤销；右上角「重刻」可以只重刻当前这一步，或者整方从头再来。刻完点印面上的「吹」把石粉吹干净，印石转一圈展示，印蜕收进右上角的「印谱」，同时解锁下一方。印面上刻的是反字，盖出来才是正的。电脑上同理，用鼠标按住刀柄或握把拖动。键盘：方向键移刀，R 横竖转刀，按住空格下刀，同时按方向键顺着刀推或往回推，松开提刀，Z 撤销，Q 和 E 转动印石，B 吹粉，A 打开印谱。
howToPlay.en: Carve a four-character seal the way a seal carver does: chamfer the face's edges, cut the border, cut a cross into four cells, then carve the characters stroke by stroke. The knife has two zones: drag the white handle to move it, hold the cinnabar grip (or the blade) and swipe to carve. The small ring on the face is the cutting point: the bar across it is the edge and the groove's width, the arrows show the ways it can go; it is yellow while the knife hovers, red while it is in the stone. Near a red draft line of the current step the point settles onto it (onto its end when near one), and the line turns yellow when it is aimed; Line assist can be switched off in Settings. Upright, the knife cuts up and down; across, left and right; ⟳ just below the cutting point switches. It cuts either way, and slides along ground already cut. While cutting the knife turns see-through so the groove shows. Letting go lifts it; hold the grip again to carry on. ↶ beside ⟳ takes back the last swipe, again and again; Redo (top right) starts the current step, or the whole seal, over. When all is cut, tap Blow on the face to clear the powder; the stone turns once, and the print goes into Seals (top right) and the next seal opens. The face is carved mirrored so that it prints the right way round. With a mouse, drag the handle or the grip the same way. Keyboard: arrow keys move the knife, R turns it; hold Space to put it in, an arrow along the knife pushes either way, let go to lift it; Z undoes, Q and E turn the stone, B blows, A opens your seals.
